title: Require Generic Service Anchor Exports
forbids: a service base without the sole direct os.$context<Context>() anchor; a root implementation without direct unconfigured impl and configured service stages; a root or module directory entrypoint without its generic contract or router anchor; a module.ts without its generic module anchor; an extra runtime spine export; or any second module export
why: Closed generic anchors make declaration, implementation, configuration, module wiring, and router composition visible without qualified aliases or hidden factories.
remediate: Export base = os.$context<Context>() from base.ts. Export the unconfigured impl and configured service from impl.ts. Export contract and router from root spine files and module directory index.ts entrypoints, export module from module.ts, and remove alternate runtime anchors, factories, compatibility exports, and module type exports.
message: Each service spine file must directly export its generic local anchor.
